items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled OUT with ankle injury (left game).
items.implication: Zero rest of game; monitor severity for ROS.
items.opportunity: Major target bump to Jordan Addison and other MIN WRs.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled OUT with rib injury (was active/expected after hip Q).
items.why: Carted in Q1; full eval tomorrow, painful per Rapoport.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets to remaining SF pass-catchers.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers active and will make 2026 season debut (knee).
items.why: Confirmed on inactives; expected per ETR.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside in return; start confidently.
items.opportunity: High route/target share likely as feature TE.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled OUT vs Chiefs (knee); coach Hafley 'does not sound very optimistic' on major injury.
items.why: Knee; initial eval pessimistic per coach/Rapoport.
items.implication: Significant absence risk ROS; handcuff immediate.
items.opportunity: Full backfield work to remaining MIA RBs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs. Cowboys after pregame workout on hamstring; likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout looked good; Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable but docked snaps/usage; late swap value.
items.opportunity: Limited routes/targets possible; monitor actual snap share.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF (hip/groin ongoing).
items.opportunity: Elevated work to Davante Adams and other LAR WRs.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled OUT with thigh injury.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps to Jets backup RBs.

items.text: Berry: Risky but if Zay Flowers active for Ravens he's active for me; start over Bateman.
items.why: Active confirmation enough despite hamstring risk and prior GTD.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell expected inactive (finger, prior high targets); Levitan depth chart: Garrett Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Jamaal Pritchett, Sterling Shepard, Malik McLain + TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 with expanded opportunity; Sadiq hybrid upside.
items.opportunity: Higher target/route share for Wilson and remaining Jets WRs/TE.

items.text: ETR/Levitan projecting DJ Moore in but limited (shoulder); later confirmed active/expected.
items.why: No early info then assumed limited; Schefter/Rapoport active.
items.opportunity: If more limited, bump to other BUF pass-catchers.

items.text: ETR/Levitan initially projecting Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring) with late-swap eye on Bateman/Andrews DFS; team not counting on him pre-workout.
items.why: No early confirmation; conservative dock then reverse on active news.
items.implication: DFS pivot to Bateman/Andrews if limited or out; standard start if full-ish.
items.opportunity: If limited, elevated TE/WR2 opportunity in BAL.
items.conflict: Initial OUT proj vs later ACTIVE confirmation.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM: Jaylen Warren and Michael Pittman expected to play; later confirmed active.
items.why: Weekend reports; Schefter expected, actives confirm.
items.opportunity: Warren volume if Dowdle limited previously.

items.text: ETR comprehensive Sunday AM: Flowers GTD (not counting); Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman; Q: Parkinson trending right, Bagent.
items.implication: Prioritize expected actives; monitor Flowers/Spears closely pre-kick.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries if any GTD tips OUT.

items.text: Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop, DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both weeks, RB7 utilization; PIT soft vs RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high YPR to WRs.
Berry loves Dalton Schultz @ IND (and 10 Facts): 28-30% target share last week with Nico Collins out; IND soft vs TEs.
items.why: Collins absence drove TE targets; matchup continues upside.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target share if Collins out.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches); 10 Facts note TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched him rest of game. Still ranks Stevenson ahead but gap narrowed.
items.why: Fumble led to clear benching/split shift; tough JAX run D.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead short-term.
